figma.label: Figma

mcp.name: figma
mcp.signIn: run /mcp in Claude Code and sign in with your own Figma account
mcp.writes: use_figma, generate_figma_design, html_to_figma and others edit the canvas

figma.handoffs: Variables through the Tokens Studio plugin (tokens); exported SVG, PNG or PDF (files)
figma.notes: Read calls are rate limited per seat: View and Collab seats get 20 a month, Dev and Full seats 200 a day (Professional). Use a Dev or Full seat, and read variables once per node per sync. Location: the file URL with the node-id of each frame that matters. The desktop server is only for org or enterprise needs

penpot.label: Penpot

mcp.name: penpot
mcp.signIn: create an MCP key in Penpot (Integrations) and export it as PENPOT_MCP_KEY in your shell; self-hosted Penpot: change the domain
mcp.writes: execute_code runs plugin code that can change the file; import_image adds images

penpot.handoffs: Design token export (JSON); exported SVG or PNG
penpot.notes: Penpot's docs describe its tokens as DTCG ($value, $type); a community report says the export follows Tokens Studio's shape instead. Check the keys before mapping. MCP is active in one browser tab at a time, and the local server needs the MCP plugin open in Penpot

sketch.label: Sketch

mcp.name: sketch
mcp.signIn: start the MCP server in Sketch (2025.2.4 or later, direct download, not the App Store build) and allow Local Network access
mcp.writes: run_code runs SketchAPI scripts that can change the document

sketch.notes: Local only: the server runs inside Sketch on each person's Mac. get_design_assets returns colour swatches, text styles, layer styles and symbols; colour variables are not documented

webflow.label: Webflow

mcp.name: webflow
mcp.signIn: run /mcp in Claude Code, sign in and authorize the site; launch the Webflow MCP Bridge App in the Designer for design tools
read: variables and styles (tool names not documented)
mcp.writes: set_style, set_text and the variable and style tools edit the site; no read-only mode

webflow.handoffs: Site code export (code); the published site (link)
webflow.notes: The README also lists an /sse endpoint for other clients; Claude Code uses /mcp. No read-only scope, so name the read tool in every call

canva.label: Canva
canva.handoffs: Exported PDF, PNG or SVG (files); brand kit colours and fonts
canva.notes: Canva has an official MCP server (OAuth per person), but its URL wasn't confirmed on 2026-10-28: add it by hand from canva.com/help/mcp-agent-setup as "canva" in .mcp.json. Brand kits need Canva Pro or above

framer.label: Framer
framer.notes: No official MCP server: the Framer MCP plugin is third party (unframer), so it isn't set up by the kit

stitch.label: Google Stitch
stitch.handoffs: DESIGN.md export (tokens); HTML and CSS export (code)
stitch.notes: An MCP setup page exists at stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup but its contents weren't confirmed on 2026-10-28; the DESIGN.md export is confirmed only by third parties

claude-design.label: Claude Design
claude-design.handoffs: Handoff to Claude Code (send to the local coding agent, or to Claude Code on the web), standalone HTML export (code); zip, PDF or PPTX export (files)
claude-design.notes: No MCP server. The handoff's contents aren't documented: list what arrived before reading it. /design-sync pulls a design system into Claude Design; nothing documents a sync back out

claude-artifact.label: Claude artifact
claude-artifact.handoffs: The artifact URL, read with the Artifact tool
claude-artifact.notes: Your own artifact reads back as raw HTML; one shared with you reads back as a summary only. Ask its owner for edit access or an export
